title: ci(spec-shape-gate): red since objectui#12957 — the gate runs `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` in objectui, whose @objectstack/* now resolve from a pin build only `pnpm run setup` creates; the release gate reads this run, so next.4 is held
body:
Filing gate **①**, class (a): a scheduled gate on `main` is red, and the release gate reads it. Filed by the triage seat (seat post #6015, `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`). ⛔ Not a claim.

## What is red

- **Run:** `Spec Shape Gate` schedule run `39184618583` (the :52 slot, started 01:16Z), upstream `71fa166e96`, downstream objectui `4b7ce47051`. Job `117844299175`, read with MCP `get_job_logs`.
- **Step 14, "Install objectui dependencies"** (`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, `.github/workflows/spec-shape-gate.yml:241`), exits 254:
  `ENOENT: no such file or directory, scandir '…/objectui/node_modules/.cache/objectstack/client'`
- So steps 16–17 (the inject and the compile) are skipped. The report exits 2 ("no log, no reading, never a pass").
- **The last green run** was `39178346999` (23:53Z), on objectui before `749ed760`.

## Why

objectstack-ai/objectui#12957 (PR #12963, merged as `749ed760` at 00:27Z) moved every `@objectstack/*` package in objectui's root `package.json` to `file:node_modules/.cache/objectstack/<name>`. That directory exists only after `scripts/objectstack-pin.mjs build`, which `pnpm run setup` runs before its frozen install. The gate still runs a bare frozen install. objectui#13008 (Dependabot) and #24306 (the console build) are the same consumer change, at two other entry points.

## Why it is p1

`scripts/ci/scheduled-full-run.mjs --release-gate` (release.yml's `full-battery` job) requires the newest `Spec Shape Gate` schedule run at or before the version commit to be `success`. Every hourly run is red until this lands, so merging #24168 (next.4) now would publish nothing: the release gate refuses it.

## Wanted (the shape is the lane's; this is the reading)

objectui's own stand-in input is made for this: `OBJECTSTACK_ROOT=<tree> node scripts/objectstack-pin.mjs build` packs every `@objectstack/*` from an existing objectstack tree in place of the pin (objectui `scripts/objectstack-pin.mjs:49`, written for #24306). With `OBJECTSTACK_ROOT=$GITHUB_WORKSPACE`, then `pnpm run setup`:
- objectui compiles against **this commit's** packages. The gate today injects only `@objectstack/spec`, so with this the gate reads all seven. The inject step then either retires or stays as a no-op, and the lane says which.
- ⚠️ **To measure:** objectui's lockfile depends on the packed manifests' dependencies, peers and engines. If this tree's packages changed one of those since objectui's pin (`2c9bf9430a`), the frozen install refuses. Say whether the gate then reads it as a known class (an objectui pin bump owed), or as a new red.

## Done when

1. A `Spec Shape Gate` run on `main` installs objectui, compiles it, and reports `success` (or a real, attributed shape break).
2. The gate's self-test and its `pull_request` path filter still prove the registry reading on the gate's own PR.

**Lane:** `domain:devx`. `.github/workflows/spec-shape-gate.yml` is governed (`.github/workflows/**`, Tier H, the maintainer's hand merge). `scripts/ci/spec-shape-gate.mjs` is not.
**Release:** #24168 is held until one green scheduled run lands after the fix.

**Dedupe:** semantic searches here and on objectui for "Spec Shape Gate objectui install node_modules/.cache/objectstack pinned build frozen lockfile" turned up only the siblings #24306 and objectui#13008, and the closed shape-break cards of the gate's history.
